criteria: Phase 3 Experiment 1: the pre-registered analysis (proposal 0006, sections 7 and 8).
This file is frozen before any Experiment 1 agent is trained: the experiment manifest records its
SHA-256, and the report refuses to run if the file has changed since. Every threshold and test
used to judge the experiment is defined here and nowhere else.
Unit of analysis: the seed (six independent agents per group). Each agent is judged on its FINAL
checkpoint only (no selection), on two fresh evaluation rounds of 20 test runs each (40 runs).
An intervention group shows genuine improvement over the replicated control only if ALL hold:
G1  mean decision quality Q2.0 above control: exact one-sided permutation test across seeds
(all 924 relabellings of 6 + 6), Holm-corrected across the four intervention groups,
adjusted p < 0.05, and effect (group mean - control mean) at least +0.5
G2  ruinous-decision share below 1% in at least 5 of 6 seeds
G3  median position size within 0.5x to 2x of the growth-optimal size in at least 4 of 6 seeds
G4  in at least 4 of 6 seeds: mean realised log growth over the 40 runs above zero with its 95%
bootstrap interval above zero, AND in each round above the 95th percentile of ten
leverage- and turnover-matched random agents
G5  replication: the Q2 effect over control is positive in each of the two rounds separately
G6  training history: ruinous share in the last 20% of training episodes below the first 20%
(or below 0.1% in both: nothing left to fall from) in at least 4 of 6 seeds
Reward-exploitation checks (all must be clear):
E1  no training-path advantage: mean (Q2 on own training paths - Q2 on fresh data) <= 0.5
E2  no reliance on simulator boundaries: mean share of decisions at 1,000x or more (half the
1:2000 margin limit) below 0.1%
E3  noise-driven sizing: median across seeds of the previous-move tilt below 1.5 (tilt =
max(r, 1/r), r = mean size after a previous-bar move above +2 sd / after one below -2 sd,
sd = 1.4826 x median absolute deviation of bar returns, so that crashes do not inflate it;
S6 bar returns are independent, so the right value is 1)
E4  rejected orders: mean share of decisions with a rejected order no more than control + 0.1 pp
Learning from catastrophe (K): in training, ruinous share in the 50 training episodes after each
death minus the 50 before, averaged over the agent's deaths (seeds with 5+ deaths). Must be
negative (exact one-sided sign-flip test across seeds, p < 0.05). With fewer than 3 such seeds it
is reported as not measurable and does not block. If the control shows a similar fall, the fall
is reported as not attributable to the intervention.

approval_conditions: 1 All existing agents, versions, checkpoints, reward rules and historical records untouched.
2 Completely separate experimental branch (git branch claude/phase3-exp1; separate registry registry-phase3/) with independent agent identities and version histories.
3 Five groups exactly as proposed: existing-settings control; size representation 1 (C1); size representation 2 (C2); steadier training updates (D); longer learning horizon (A).
5 Evaluation criteria frozen before training begins.
6 Every final checkpoint evaluated; no candidate selection from intermediate performance.
7 All checkpoints and failed experiments preserved; separate storage preferred over lower checkpoint frequency.
8 Report statistical uncertainty, effect sizes and individual seed results; no overstated conclusions.
9 Reward function and all frozen rules unchanged.
10 No exposure caps, additional penalties or manually imposed trading strategies.
Experiment 2 (persistent exploration on S3) is separate and must not interfere with Experiment 1.
No reward-function modification is investigated or implemented.

compute.estimate: about 5 h training on 4 cores (12.4 min per 1M steps per job, 4 jobs in parallel) plus about 1.5 h of evaluation

decision_quality.definition: Per decision with net exposure G (position value / equity): s(G) = max(g(G) / g(G*), F), and s(G) = F for a ruinous decision. g(G) = (1 - p) E_Z[ln(1 + G (e^(m + sigma Z) - 1))] + p ln(1 - G J) is the exact expected log growth of holding G for one decision (96-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature; minus infinity if G >= 1/J). G* = argmax g. F = g(G_ruin) / g(G*), the score of the smallest ruinous long position (G_ruin = 0.95 / J in S6; for a market without crashes, the size at which a 5-sigma fall reaches the 5% death line). Ruinous: G >= G_ruin long, or |G| >= 0.95 / (e^(m + 5 sigma) - 1) short. Q2 of an episode = mean of s over its decisions; Q2 of an evaluation = mean of the episode values. Uses only the decisions and the market's known parameters, never realised returns.

frozen: S6 market mechanics, reward R1, death at 5%, margin 1:2000, simulator, costs, Q2.0 score, phase 2 gate criteria, open trading principle. No exposure cap, no new penalty, no trading style.

C1.description: size output z with G = e^z (z in [-25, 25], numerical safeguard only)

C2.description: size output z with G = softplus(z) = ln(1 + e^z) (z in [-25, 10,000], numerical safeguard only)

D.description: steadier updates: learning rate 1e-4, 4 epochs per update, KL limit 0.02 per update

control.description: existing settings: size output u, G = 10^(4u); PPO lr 3e-4, 10 epochs, no KL limit, gamma 0.99

predictions: P-C (from the diagnosis, hypotheses H1/H2): C1 and C2 reduce the ruinous-decision share relative to control.
P-D (H3): D lowers per-update KL and clip fraction and the previous-move tilt relative to control.
P-A (falsification of the horizon explanation): A does not meet G1 and does not reduce the mean ruinous share by more than half relative to control.
If none of C1, C2 or D meets the criteria, the evidence points at the reward basin (finding F4); any change to the reward would need a separate proposal and the owner's approval.

storage.estimate: about 6-8 MB per agent, about 200-330 MB for the experiment
storage.note: Permanent blobs of this registry (checkpoints, optimiser/RNG state, training histories, decision samples) live on the separate branch above, checked out next to this repository. Git LFS was refused by GitHub for this repository (public fork), so a dedicated blobs-only branch is used.
